title: Prism Note
body: The relay prism produces a ghost image only when the operator truly means both options. Indecision without sincerity leaves the glass dark.

title: Phase Note
body: The dial once had numbered positions. Every mark after three was polished away, as if higher settings had been deliberately forgotten.

title: Signal Map Note
body: The signal map lists routes through impossible coordinates. Several are tagged with operator initials that never appear in the public archive.

title: Drawer Note
body: Inside the drawer lining is a pressure mark exactly the size of a missing seal. The Archivist appears to reward replacements over explanations.

title: Waveform Note
body: The scope measures anticipation rather than outcome. The relay seems more interested in the moment before choice than in choice itself.

title: Lamp Bank Note
body: The smallest lamp always glows first, but it is not wired into the visible stage list. Something hidden decides the order before the console does.

title: First Bifurcation
body: After the first split, the relay stops treating you like a visitor. The Bridge begins to record your presence as part of its own history.

title: Balanced Signal
body: When both branches have been inhabited, the relay tone changes. It becomes less like an oracle and more like a witness.
